blocks.text: The module documentation explains why binary presence is insufficient and lists the containment guarantees being tested. Constants and imports define check names, bounded execution, and cache support.
blocks.title: Security-critical probe contract

blocks.text: RunResult captures bounded subprocess output, CheckOutcome gives each check a fixed status, and ProbeResult aggregates the verdict with failure and description helpers.
blocks.title: Probe result records

blocks.text: default_runner starts a new process group, captures output, truncates it, and kills the group on timeout. classify_start_failure maps bubblewrap startup text to stable failure codes.
blocks.title: Bounded subprocess execution

blocks.text: _World creates fake home/project directories, files, canaries, and unique identifiers, and cleans them up. The marker helper optionally starts a harmless host process for process-visibility checks.
blocks.title: Temporary test world

blocks.text: The check factory returns named predicates for filesystem visibility, writes, parent escape, /proc, environment, toolchain paths, denied paths, and host-process visibility.
blocks.title: Containment checks

blocks.text: run_probe supplies defaults and timing, while _run_probe builds the bubblewrap command, runs each check, converts setup and timeout failures, and closes the temporary world. session_probe caches one result per distinct settings.
blocks.title: Fresh filesystem probe

blocks.text: NetworkProbeResult summarizes proxy/direct-network checks. _FakeUpstream is a blocking loopback server that sends a banner and counts connections.
blocks.title: Network verdict and fake upstream

blocks.text: The network probe parses child replies, starts controlled upstream/proxy fixtures, runs the sandboxed client, and evaluates proxy-only and direct-access behavior before cleanup.
blocks.title: Network containment test

blocks.text: Host-side permissions verify the proxy directory and socket are private. session_network_probe runs the network test once per settings key and remembers its result.
blocks.title: Network privacy and cache

gotchas: A probe failure is different from setup failure and timeout.
Network results depend on a controlled proxy/upstream fixture.
The module intentionally performs real subprocess and socket operations.

Executes named containment checks and records fixed outcomes
Runs fresh filesystem/process probe or returns a settings cache
Runs controlled network probe with fake upstream/proxy and validates host-side privacy
purpose: The probe creates a temporary fake home/project world, runs controlled commands through bubblewrap, checks canaries and kernel-visible evidence, and caches results per settings. Its network half uses a private fake upstream and proxy to distinguish allowed proxy traffic from direct network access.
summary: Self-tests bubblewrap filesystem, process, and network containment before declaring the sandbox active.
